decision: No demonstrated practical reliability gain under the unchanged bounded pipeline. Retain Qwen default; Gemma remains an explicit optional comparison model, never publication approval.

method.comparison: One verified Gemma E4B QAT Q4_0 candidate, one vendor-decoding configuration, no prompt/model/precision tuning. Same frozen ten plus reserve four, same generation stages and acceptance guards, fresh Qwen control. Warm original-four runs are timing repetitions, not independent quality cases.
method.source_assessment: Agent inspection against exact committed source excerpts and predeclared expectations, not another model or exact-string proxy. Every accepted five-locale body was inspected; repeated identical bodies were identified separately. These are review-draft assessments, not certified human review or proof of entailment.
method.quality_rule: A source-consistent review draft must describe the actual candidate behavior with no identified unsupported material claim or untranslated prose, preserve cutoff/modality/identifiers, and contain all five locales. Awkward wording still requires editing. A correct insufficient decision requires agreement with source expectations. Machine completion alone is not task success.
method.limits: Small previously inspected corpus; material-delta duplicates Base64. Vendor sampling differs from greedy Qwen. Platform, criticality and complexity are deliberately unknown by construction, not measured known-value extraction. Shared host, no forcibly purged file cache, no statistical or general model-ranking claim.

native_capture.contents: Exact upstream API/model/conversion/decoding records, native compatibility, complete requests/raw outputs/refusals/timings/runtime logs and metadata, frozen manifests, candidate proposals and warm benchmark results. No weights or executables.

pins.template_note: Exactly official pinned canonical template minus its final newline. No custom template or compatibility correction.
pins.native_backend: Apple M1 Pro 16GiB/macOS26.7/Metal, 43 of 43 layers, 7.46B text GGUF parameters; model family 4.5B effective/about8B with per-layer embeddings.

gemma.quality_note: Japanese events captures the primary event change/18R6 and official aliases, but event-order phrasing is awkward and must be edited. No candidate is publication-ready.

qwen.quality_note: All accepted bodies reproduce the earlier source-inspected Qwen capture exactly. Still awkward grammar and no human review; zero identified unsupported accepted claims is an observation, not an entailment guarantee.

cases.name: base64
cases.gemma: Machine accepted; behavior/cutoff and official French alias match, but Spanish paragraph retains English 'called on'. Generic title omits actual empty-BLOB result. Localization task failure, not a fully correct draft.
cases.qwen: Source-consistent review draft; same inspected prior body, awkward Spanish grammar.

cases.name: unknown
cases.gemma: UNSUPPORTED ACCEPTED CLAIM: conditions add empty text/blob INPUT as an alternative to invalid base64. Source only says invalid base64 INPUT produces empty text/blob OUTPUT. All five locales carry the error despite valid references/schema; correct unknown metadata does not rescue it.
cases.qwen: Unknown release/remedy and invalid-input meaning appropriate; refused Japanese title retaining Invalid.

cases.name: listbox
cases.gemma: Incorrect insufficient decision; discards a documented optional guard. Safe no-draft result but task failure, not a correct refusal.
cases.qwen: Optional instruction extracted correctly; English still says must and uses E1 as rationale; numeric-reference refusal is not semantic verification. Neither model authors the optional remedy successfully.

cases.name: french-restriction
cases.gemma: Restriction/19R4 right. Japanese guard rejects version-only condition '4Dv 19 R4', a script-heuristic false positive rather than untranslated English. Other condition becomes use of ternary operator rather than identifier scope; no complete draft or semantic pass.
cases.qwen: Restriction/19R4 right; digit heuristic falsely rejects 3項演算子=ternary operator. No complete draft.

cases.name: japanese-events
cases.gemma: Accepted five-locale review draft: primary click-during-editing behavior, 18R6, official French Sur clic/Sur double clic and column-before-list-box intent retained. Event-order sentences and list-box terminology are awkward and require human editing.
cases.qwen: Correct type/cutoff, but English echoes Japanese twice; refused at English script guard.

cases.name: optional-not-mandatory
cases.gemma: Correct insufficient decision; not-required alone is no new change.
cases.qwen: Correct insufficient decision; no new mandatory work.

cases.name: undated-deprecation
cases.gemma: Deprecation/unknown cutoff right. English adds unsolicited migrating-away suggestion. Japanese contains Japanese translation plus English parenthetical interprocess variables; strict language guard refuses it, not proof the whole field is untranslated.
cases.qwen: Deprecation/unknown cutoff right; German copies English title and is refused.

cases.name: irrelevant-context
cases.gemma: Incorrect removal classification and claims scheduled removal of unnamed items from a rhetorical lead-in. Downstream numeric guard rejects leaked E1 reference; not a correct insufficient decision or semantic-validator success.

cases.name: material-delta
cases.gemma: Correct material-change routing, exact Base64 bodies including untranslated Spanish called on. Not an independent generative case or a quality success.
cases.qwen: Correct bounded material-change review draft, duplicates Base64.

cases.name: ok-variable
cases.gemma: STRUCTURALLY ACCEPTED BUT WRONG CANDIDATE CONTENT: selects generic introduction E1, omits OK and actual no-longer-modified behavior everywhere. Factually generic source prose is not an adequate OK-variable patch; wrong evidence relevance/task failure.
cases.qwen: Source-consistent OK-variable review draft with18R4; no invented command identity or remedy. Same prior body, language editing needed.

cases.name: french-pdf-deprecation
cases.gemma: Wrong removal type, false unknown cutoff because shared parser misses à partir de20, French mixed into English, wrong-locale constant and E1 prose markers. Numeric-marker refusal is separate from semantic errors.
cases.qwen: Wrong restriction type, same parser cutoff miss and no-longer-supports/replaced distortion; wrong-locale alias refusal is separate from semantic errors.

cases.name: empty-aggregate-results
cases.gemma: English retains correct Undefined-versus-Null behavior and methods. Shared parser falsely forces unknown cutoff for prior to18R6. Japanese min/max/average/Undefined/Null are legitimate code, so min refusal is a language-heuristic false positive; Japanese 18R6以前 also blurs exclusive prior-to boundary. No complete valid proposal.
cases.qwen: Functional result meaning correct but shared cutoff miss; paragraph omits exact entitySelection, refused.

cases.name: recommendation-only
cases.gemma: Correct insufficient decision; advice alone is no changed migration fact.

cost.note: Cold means fresh process, not cleared file cache. One model at a time; all servers stopped afterwards. Warm accepted bodies and statuses match cold, with the same refusal rules; no new quality observations. Process-tree RSS is approximate and omits precise unified-memory/file-cache/PLE accounting.
